concerns.text: The schema states 'Variance percentage. Must be < 5% per SC-002', but the spec contains NO SC-002 (success criteria jump SC-001 → SC-003). This is a plan element with no backing FR/SC: no phase in plan.md's Requirement Coverage table produces sensitivity_report.json, no data-model entity describes it, and no quickstart output lists it. Either the spec is missing an SC-002 (sensitivity analysis of the MSD fit start fraction 0.1/0.2/0.3) — which US2 ('validate methodological rigor via sensitivity analysis') strongly suggests was dropped — or the orphan contract must be removed. As written, the implementer has no task satisfying it and the SC won't be measured.
